title: Piping QAQC Engineer
description:
Mechanical / Piping QA/QC Engineer – Power Plant / Energy Projects

Location: Singapore
Employment Type: Contract
Industry: Power Generation / Energy / Engineering

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Mechanical / Piping QA/QC Engineer to support quality assurance and quality control activities for major power plant, Waste-to-Energy and industrial energy projects in Singapore.

The successful candidate will be responsible for inspections, piping quality documentation, welding/NDT coordination, testing and system completion activities throughout construction, pre-commissioning and handover.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform QA/QC inspections for mechanical and piping works throughout project execution.
  • Implement and maintain Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), inspection procedures and quality documentation.
  • Inspect piping fabrication, installation, fit-up, welding and mechanical equipment installation.
  • Review P&IDs, piping isometrics, piping layouts, specifications and approved construction drawings.
  • Verify piping materials, valves, fittings, flanges and associated components against approved specifications.
  • Monitor welding activities, including WPS/PQR compliance, welder qualifications and welding records.
  • Coordinate and witness NDT activities including RT, UT, MT and PT where applicable.
  • Prepare, review and maintain weld maps, inspection records and piping quality documentation.
  • Raise and coordinate Inspection Requests with contractors, clients and third-party inspectors.
  • Support preparation and review of piping test packs and verify test boundaries.
  • Witness hydrostatic/pneumatic testing, flushing, cleaning, reinstatement and leak testing.
  • Conduct piping walkdowns and identify punch-list items and non-conforming works.
  • Raise and support closure of NCRs, corrective actions and quality observations.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, HSE, vendors and subcontractors.
  • Support mechanical completion and pre-commissioning activities.
  • Verify completion of piping systems prior to turnover to the commissioning team.
  • Maintain inspection reports, material records, test reports and quality documentation.
  • Support preparation of quality dossiers, turnover packages and final handover documentation.
  • Ensure works comply with project specifications, approved procedures and applicable codes and standards.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Relevant experience as a Mechanical QA/QC Engineer, Piping QA/QC Engineer or Mechanical/Piping Inspector.
  • Experience within power plants, Waste-to-Energy, process plants, petrochemical, utilities or major industrial projects is highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of piping fabrication, installation, welding and inspection activities.
  • Able to read and interpret P&IDs, piping isometrics and mechanical drawings.
  • Familiar with WPS, PQR, welder qualifications and welding documentation.
  • Good understanding of NDT methods and inspection requirements.
  • Experience preparing/reviewing test packs, weld maps and inspection records.
  • Experience with hydrotesting, pneumatic testing, flushing, reinstatement and piping walkdowns.
  • Familiarity with ITPs, Inspection Requests, NCRs and punch-list management.
  • Knowledge of applicable ASME, API and AWS standards is advantageous.
  • Relevant certifications such as CSWIP, AWS-CWI, API or ASNT NDT Level II would be advantageous.
  • Able to work effectively with contractors, third-party inspectors and multidisciplinary project teams.

Preferred Experience

Power Plant | Waste-to-Energy | Piping QA/QC | Mechanical QA/QC | P&IDs | Isometrics | Test Packs | Weld Maps | Welding | WPS/PQR | NDT | Hydrotesting | Pneumatic Testing | Flushing | Reinstatement | ITP | NCR | Punch Listing | Mechanical Completion | Pre-Commissioning | Handover

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently supervise daily metal recycling operations across multiple locations in Singapore, including loading/unloading, manual sorting, mechanical segregation, weighing, processing and organised storage.

  • Verify incoming and outgoing scrap grades, identify contamination and mixed materials, and resolve grading or weight discrepancies before processing or dispatch.

  • Operate and supervise hydraulic shears, cable strippers and related recycling equipment in accordance with operating procedures and safety requirements.

  • Plan daily manpower allocation, machine utilisation and processing schedules to achieve output targets while maintaining material quality and safe working conditions.

  • Monitor material recovery rates, processing losses and stock movements; investigate discrepancies and implement corrective measures.

  • Maintain accurate inventory records using Microsoft Excel or ERP systems, reconcile physical stock against system balances, and ensure supporting weighing and delivery records are complete.

  • Implement site risk controls, conduct safety briefings, and enforce applicable MOM workplace safety and NEA environmental requirements.

  • Conduct equipment inspections, identify signs of mechanical or hydraulic faults, and coordinate preventive maintenance and repairs. Ensure unsafe equipment is taken out of service.

  • Train and supervise site workers in scrap identification, segregation methods, safe equipment use and housekeeping.

  • Coordinate with logistics and trading teams, transport contractors and equipment suppliers to meet collection, processing and delivery schedules.

  • Submit daily reports covering stock availability, production output, recovery rates, machine downtime, manpower deployment and operational issues.

Essential Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in engineering, industrial operations, environmental management or a related discipline; equivalent technical qualifications supported by substantial relevant experience will also be considered.

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in metal recycling or scrap processing, including at least 2 years supervising yard or plant operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently identify and grade ferrous and non-ferrous scrap, including copper, aluminum, stainless steel, brass, zinc and cables.

  • Practical experience identifying contamination, distinguishing mixed grades and assessing how material composition affects recovery and processing methods.

  • Hands-on experience operating or directly supervising hydraulic shears and wire/cable strippers, including pre-start inspections, operating adjustments and safe shutdown procedures.

  • Ability to plan manpower and machine allocation, resolve processing bottlenecks and manage competing collection and dispatch priorities.

  • Ability to reconcile weighing records, stock movements and physical inventory, investigate variances and document corrective action.

  • Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting/filtering and stock reconciliation worksheets, or equivalent inventory functions in an ERP system.

  • Ability to interpret machine operating manuals, process flow charts, maintenance checklists and safe work procedures.

  • Practical understanding of workplace risk assessments, machinery isolation procedures, traffic management and safe material handling.

  • Ability to conduct site inspections and supervise work in outdoor recycling yards involving walking, standing, uneven ground, noise, dust and moving machinery, using the required protective equipment and safety controls.

  • Willingness to travel between assigned operating locations in Singapore.

  • Strong supervisory skills, with the ability to give clear work instructions, conduct safety briefings and prepare accurate operational reports.

Preferred Requirements

  • Basic knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems sufficient to recognise faults and communicate repair requirements to qualified technicians.

  • Experience improving recovery rates, reducing contamination, controlling stock losses or reducing equipment downtime.

  • Experience maintaining records for environmental, safety or ISO management system audits.

title: Scrum Master (Jr/Mid Level)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Scrum Master (Jr/Mid Level) based in Brazil.

This role supports two high-impact digital delivery teams focused on Voice and Chat channels. You will help ensure product work moves smoothly from ideation and backlog refinement through sprint completion and release. Working closely with Product Owners, technical teams, vendors, and contractors, you will act as a facilitator, coach, and delivery advocate. The role combines hands-on sprint management with data-driven performance monitoring and continuous improvement. You will help remove blockers, strengthen Agile practices, and maintain transparency across complex delivery activities. This is an opportunity to contribute directly to disciplined, predictable, and high-quality product delivery in a collaborative IT environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Own end-to-end sprint management across Voice and Chat delivery teams, ensuring work is clearly defined, sequenced, tracked, and completed.
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Ensure features and work items consistently follow established Scrum processes, proactively identifying gaps, bottlenecks, and deviations.
  • Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized, well-groomed backlogs with clear acceptance criteria and dependencies.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for impediments, proactively identifying blockers and driving them toward resolution.
  • Track and analyze Agile performance metrics such as sprint velocity, throughput, defect leakage, cycle time, and delivery quality.
  • Prepare regular performance updates and communicate delivery insights clearly to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Facilitate retrospectives that result in actionable improvements, tracking commitments through to completion.
  • Coach teams and stakeholders on Agile principles and best practices while promoting transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and current sprint information in Aha! or comparable Agile management tools, ensuring reliable visibility into delivery status.

    • Requirements:

    • 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead supporting technical product or platform teams.
    • Hands-on experience managing sprints and backlogs using Aha!, Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable Agile project management tools.
    • Strong facilitation skills and the ability to lead effective Scrum ceremonies across multiple teams.
    • Demonstrated ability to define, measure, analyze, and communicate Agile performance metrics, including velocity, defect leakage, and delivery quality.
    • Proven ability to collaborate with Product Owners, technical teams, senior stakeholders, vendors, and contractors in a matrixed environment.
    • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to keep complex delivery activities on schedule.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn delivery data and status updates into clear, actionable information for leadership.
    • Experience supporting contact center, voice, or digital channel technology teams is an advantage.
    • Familiarity with flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, commuter benefits, or other consumer-directed benefits is a plus.

title: Departmental Requirements Officer (DRO)
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
MELE Associates is seeking a DRO to support the DOE Office of Intelligence and Counterintelligence's Intelligence Directorate, Analytic Support Division. They shall provide GEOINT national technical means and commercial collection requirement systems support. The individual shall be responsible for assisting in the planning and organizing of GEOINT specific integrated collection requirement strategies using complex, coherent and systematic intelligence collection campaigns employing national and theater assets against nuclear and energy-related targets world-wide. They will support the Director, Analytic Support Division.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Responsible for assisting in the planning and organizing of integrated, GEOINT collection requirement strategies using complex, coherent and systematic intelligence collection campaigns employing national and theater assets against nuclear and energy-related targets worldwide.
  • Work with a team of discipline specific and all source collection requirement managers to develop multi-discipline, department level collection requirement strategies in both complex and comprehensive generic templated approaches, as well as specifically focused ad-hoc methods.
  • Proficient in the Intelligence Community and performs a wide range of functions at the highest level of difficulty and complexity.
  • Provide GEOINT collection management and requirements analysis on assigned target areas.
  • Plan and organize, GEOINT collection requirements efforts of the DOE in using complex coherent and systematic campaigns against nuclear, science, technology, counterintelligence, and energy-related targets world-wide.
  • Submit GEOINT requirements via national level requirement systems.
  • Work effectively as a member of a diverse team, accepting and giving effective feedback, and collaborating with other collection requirement managers across the intelligence community.
  • Develop and present intelligence collection requirement management strategies and approaches.
  • Build, establish, and maintain relationships with key national, Departmental, IC and military partners.
  • Represent the Department on INT collection requirements subcommittees and working groups.
  • Assess the effectiveness of GEOINT collection.
  • Write, review, and submit GEOINT collection requirements (National, Theater, Source Directed) to include website and database updates.
  • Analyze Departmental and analyst needs to determine functional and cross-functional intelligence requirements and their relationship/performance against gaps.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active TS Security Clearance

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a related discipline with 5 years of professional experience; or 3 years of professional experience with a related master’s degree.

  • Have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in the desired collection requirement discipline (GEOINT) or operations management at the tactical, strategic or national level required.
  • Have a collection requirements background with an understanding of the National Intelligence Priority Framework (NIPF), relevant National Collection Directives, report generation and dissemination.
  • Have training and a working knowledge of discipline-specific collection requirements, evaluation and tasking systems used by originators.
  • Possess knowledge of, and skill in applying technical collection planning concepts, principles, practices, laws, regulations, and methods and techniques to include US person reporting issues.
  • Have knowledge of the full spectrum of IC collection capabilities and accesses, to include strengths and weaknesses of specific sources/agencies in a specific discipline. Knowledge of the missions and functions of agencies within the Intelligence Community who specialize in the various collections.
  • Be able to establish and maintain effective mission execution and interdepartmental and interagency coordination of the department’s collection requirements, training and tools.
  • Have experience supporting a collection requirements portfolio; understanding customer requirements; with proven skill in measuring departmental information gaps and the effectiveness of collection strategies.
  • Have successfully completed a discipline-specific training program.
  • Must have experience with, or knowledge of, GIMS, GIMS certification preferred; however, certification can be obtained if candidate has a strong background in collection requirements management, training must be completed within the first six months of employment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Knowledge of MASINT collection and systems is desirable; Experience writing, reviewing, and submitting MASINT collection requirements
  • A mixture of tactical, strategic and national-level experience and previous knowledge of the DOE and its mission

LOCATION: This is a full-time position in Washington, DC

SALARY: Salaries are determined based on several factors including external market data, internal equity, and the candidate’s related knowledge, skills, and abilities for the position. The range for this position is 70k-92k.

BENEFITS

  • Employer-paid employee Medical, Dental and Vision Care.
  • Low-Cost Family Health Care offered.
  • Federal Holidays and three (3) weeks’ vacation
  • 401(k) with Employer Match
  • Cross-training opportunities

About MELE

With over 300 employees and offices in Rockville, MD, Washington, DC, and Albuquerque, NM, MELE is a veteran-owned government contractor empowering its customers with innovative solutions for more than three decades. MELE has team members located across the U.S. and has served more than a hundred countries across hundreds of project locations. The company offers technical, engineering, and programmatic support expertise to a host of U.S. federal and international agencies, including, but not limited to, the Department of Energy, the Department of Defense, the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of Justice, INTERPOL, and the International Atomic Energy Agency. MELE’s services include national security, intelligence, IT/cybersecurity, facility management and engineering, CBRNE defense and nuclear security, emergency response training/management, and mission and program support.

The Florida Department of Corrections requires all job applicants and volunteers to pass a Level 2 background check as per Chapter 435, Florida Statutes. This check must be completed before they can start working or volunteering.

The Florida Department of Corrections (FDC) only hires U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. FDC uses E-Verify to confirm an employee’s eligibility to work after completing the I-9 form.

title: Digital Solution Engineer
description:
Overview

We are hiring a Solution Engineer (“SE”) to help support our fastest growing AI-centric startups and software development company customers to build, optimize, and scale on Microsoft Azure. This role focuses on helping earn customer trust in technical decisions by connecting our customers’ products and business outcomes to practical cloud, AI, data, and application architectures, then proving those architectures through demos, workshops, pilots, and production-readiness plans.

This requires work across account teams, specialists, partners, customer success teams, and engineering and product groups to unblock adoption, accelerate opportunities and turn customer ambition into measurable Azure usage, revenue, and long-term platform commitment. This role requires both technical depth and commercial judgement. The SE must influence and support senior technical leaders in our customer accounts to remove blockers, qualify technical risk, create repeatable patterns, and help progress opportunities across regions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technical strategy for assigned customers across the customer adoption journey from discovery through technical to close, MVP, pilot, and production adoption and scaling phases.

  • Lead architecture-led customer conversations across Azure AI, application innovation, data platforms, developer tools, cloud operations, governance, and security topics.

  • Design credible end-to-end solutions using services and technology including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AI agents, Azure Kubernetes Service, containers, serverless, APIs, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power BI, and GitHub.

  • Deliver demos, whiteboarding sessions, architecture workshops, proof of concepts, and technical validations that demonstrate clear business value and a sensible path to production for customers.

  • Translate customer product goals, business priorities, and technical complexity into decision criteria, success plans, implementation roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

  • Identify and remove technical blockers including architecture gaps, security concerns, capacity and quota constraints, migration risks, integration challenges, and operational readiness issues.

  • Partner with account executives, specialists, and customer success teams to support pipeline creation, opportunity progression, technical win documentation, milestone hygiene, and forecast quality.

  • Differentiate Microsoft against competitors by positioning Azure as a trusted, secure, scalable, and integrated platform for AI-native software companies.

  • Capture reusable patterns, lessons learned, field feedback, and customer insights so we can scale our business consistently across the globe.

    Customer scenarios this role will support

    • AI-native application development: agents, copilots, RAG, evaluation, model selection, observability, responsible AI, inference optimization, and production AI operations.

    • Cloud-native platform scaling: high-growth infrastructure, reliability, performance, capacity, quota, networking, observability, and global scale.

    • Data-driven modernization: database migration, analytics modernization, AI-ready data foundations, governance, cataloging and data integration.

    • SMB and software company growth: SaaS architecture, multi-tenant platforms, marketplace readiness, co-sell motions, developer productivity, and product-led growth.

    • Technical acceleration: workshops, hackathons, migration programs, partner-led scale motions, and repeatable delivery playbooks.

Qualifications

  • Experience in technical pre-sales, solution engineering, cloud architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing technical role.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical and business stakeholders, including CTOs, founders, engineering leaders, architects, and product leaders.

  • Hands-on understanding of cloud architecture and modern application design, including security, reliability, scalability, integration, and operations.

  • Practical experience with AI, data, analytics, application modernization or developer platform solutions on Azure or comparable cloud platforms.

  • Experience creating demos, prototypes, POCs, pilots or MVPs that lead to technical decisions and production adoption.

  • Strong communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills; ability to drive consensus without direct authority.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Depth in one or more of: Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, agentic systems, RAG, Azure Kubernetes Service, containers, serverless, API platforms, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Power BI or GitHub.

  • Experience working with startups, SMBs, SaaS, marketplace, venture-backed or product-led-growth customer scenarios.

  • Understanding of AI governance, Responsible AI, security, compliance, model evaluation, observability, cost management, and FinOps.

  • Ability to support technical sales motions across complex territories, multiple stakeholders, and fast-moving customer priorities.

  • Experience with competitive positioning and objection handling in AI, cloud platform, data, or developer tool markets.

What good looks like

  • Customer obsessed: earns trust with senior technical leaders by combining curiosity, clarity, and practical technical depth.

  • Hands-on and credible: can whiteboard, demo, prototype, and pressure-test an architecture rather than simply presenting slides.

  • Commercially aware: connects technical decisions to pipeline, consumption, revenue, growth, risk reduction, and customer outcomes.

  • Operationally disciplined: maintains clear milestones, blockers, next steps, technical win evidence, and repeatable account motions.

  • Globally collaborative: works effectively across time zones, regions, partners, and internal specialist teams.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity thrives in fast-moving environments where customer priorities, architectures, and business models evolve quickly.

title: Principal Statistician - Real World Analytics
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Principal Statistician - Real World Analytics based in India.

This role provides senior statistical expertise across real-world evidence, medical affairs, and observational research initiatives. You will contribute to study design, statistical analysis, and reporting, helping transform complex healthcare data into meaningful evidence. The position combines hands-on statistical programming with strategic input into protocols, analysis plans, datasets, and study deliverables. You will collaborate closely with programming and cross-functional teams throughout Phase 4 and non-interventional studies. Your expertise will support the development of abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and other scientific outputs. The role is well suited to an experienced statistician who enjoys applying advanced methodologies to real-world healthcare questions.

Accountabilities:

  • Provide statistical expertise and input into the design and development of observational studies and clinical trials.
  • Author and review statistical analysis plans, analysis dataset specifications, and tables, listings, and figures (TFL) shells.
  • Provide statistical support for Phase 4 non-interventional and real-world evidence studies.
  • Collaborate with programming and cross-functional teams to develop case report forms, validate datasets, and review analytical results.
  • Conduct statistical programming and analysis for Medical Affairs and real-world evidence studies using appropriate methodologies.
  • Apply advanced statistical approaches, including propensity score methods, causal inference, mixed-effects models for repeated measures, and machine learning techniques.
  • Support the interpretation and communication of study findings through abstracts, posters, manuscripts, and other scientific deliverables.
  • Contribute statistical expertise throughout the study lifecycle, ensuring analyses are scientifically sound, appropriately documented, and aligned with study objectives.

    • Requirements:

    • PhD or Master's degree in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
    • Pharmaceutical industry experience providing statistical input into study design, analysis, and reporting for interventional and observational studies.
    • At least 4 years of experience working on Phase 4 studies, Medical Affairs studies, Real World Evidence (RWE), or Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) studies.
    • At least 4 years of hands-on experience with statistical programming and analysis using SAS and R.
    • At least 4 years of experience working with SDTM and ADaM data standards.
    • At least 4 years of experience with Real World Data (RWD) and RWE methodologies, including propensity score analysis and causal inference.
    • At least 4 years of experience applying advanced statistical models, such as mixed-effects approaches for repeated measures and machine learning methods.
    • Strong understanding of clinical research, observational study methodologies, and pharmaceutical development processes.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
    • Ability to translate complex statistical concepts and findings into clear, scientifically rigorous deliverables.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work opportunity.
      • Opportunity to contribute to real-world evidence and Medical Affairs research within the pharmaceutical industry.
      • Exposure to Phase 4, observational, and clinical research programs.
      • Opportunity to apply advanced statistical methodologies, including causal inference, mixed-effects models, and machine learning.
      • Collaboration with statistical programmers and multidisciplinary research teams.
      • Opportunity to contribute to scientific publications, abstracts, posters, and manuscripts.
      • Senior-level exposure to the full lifecycle of real-world analytics and evidence-generation projects.

description:
How to apply

Email hiring@gomaxify.ai with subject: Engineering Lead - [Your Full Name]. Include your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and 2-3 examples of production systems you built or shipped. Applications that do not follow this format may not be reviewed.

About the role

We are building Maxify, an AI-native operating platform where AI colleagues execute real business workflows through company systems while remaining accountable to source data, permissions, evaluations, and measurable outcomes.

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Lead to own the technical foundations, engineering roadmap, and team needed to turn strong demand into a scalable, dependable product. You will move fluidly between architecture, implementation, debugging, product judgment, and people leadership.

This is not a coordination-only management role. You will ship production software hands-on, set the technical bar, and partner directly with the founder on product and engineering strategy.

What you will own

  • Own the technical architecture and engineering roadmap.
  • Build reliable agent systems across orchestration, memory, tools, permissions, evaluations, observability, and human oversight.
  • Lead the design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operation of AI-powered products.
  • Ship production software hands-on and lead architecture decisions and code reviews.
  • Establish standards for code quality, security, reliability, CI/CD, and speed.
  • Partner with product, data, and design teams and resolve technical risks and dependencies.
  • Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers.
  • Partner directly with the founder on product and technical strategy.

What we are looking for

  • Proven experience building and operating complex production software.
  • Active hands-on engineering depth.
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, or TypeScript.
  • Experience designing scalable cloud architecture on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Robust CI/CD experience.
  • Engineering leadership across architecture, delivery, feedback, and team development.
  • Ability to move between coding, debugging, product judgment, architecture, and team leadership.
  • Pragmatic trade-offs, clear communication, urgency, reliability, and ownership.
  • A degree is welcome, but equivalent practical experience carries equal weight.

Strong signals

  • You have personally shipped and operated complex production systems.
  • You can explain a major architecture decision, what failed, and how you prevented recurrence.
  • You remain hands-on while raising the output and judgment of engineers around you.
  • You have established measurable reliability, security, evaluation, observability, or recovery standards.
  • You use AI development tools extensively while validating outputs and retaining technical ownership.

Nice to have

  • Experience with LLM applications or agent systems.
  • Experience with distributed systems, data pipelines, or MLOps.
  • Experience with developer platforms or workflow infrastructure.
  • Startup or high-growth company experience.

AI leverage expectations

Design and operate AI colleagues that understand business context, execute workflows, use governed tools and permissions, retain appropriate memory, pass evaluations, remain observable, and escalate to humans within clear boundaries.

What this role is not

  • People management without hands-on engineering ownership.
  • Prompt writing without production software accountability.
  • Pure machine-learning research or model training.
  • Architecture work disconnected from delivery and measurable outcomes.
  • Building speculative infrastructure before real workflows require it.

Success in the first 90 days

  • Validate the target architecture and roadmap.
  • Ship material production improvements hands-on.
  • Establish measurable reliability, security, evaluation, observability, and recovery standards.
  • Clarify ownership and delivery cadence.
  • Identify the first engineering hiring and capability priorities.

How we work

  • We move quickly and build for permanence.
  • We prefer small, reversible decisions over speculative architecture.
  • Documentation, testing, evaluation, and observability are part of the product.
  • AI accelerates the work; it does not remove engineering accountability.
  • We measure success through customer outcomes, revenue impact, cost reduction, and lower operational attention.

title: Staff Experience Designer
description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.


The Opportunity

Veo’s web platform brings together some of our most important customer experiences. We are looking for a Staff Experience Designer with deep Web expertise to own design outcomes for our Core Web Experience and help raise its quality across the teams that contribute to it.

This is a hands-on, AI-first individual-contributor role. You will lead complex cross-team design work, bring a strong point of view, and support other designers with feedback, frameworks, and shared patterns.

You will partner with Stakeholders, Product Managers, and Engineers to connect customer needs, business goals, and technical realities, align teams, and carry ideas through to high-quality outcomes.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the end-to-end design of complex Core Web initiatives involving multiple teams, owning outcomes from problem framing through implementation.

  • Work hands-on across problem framing, research, interaction design, prototyping, visual design, validation, and implementation.

  • Use AI throughout the design process to expand exploration, accelerate learning, and make ideas tangible faster.

  • Partner with stakeholders across teams to bring customer insight, data, business goals, and technical trade-offs into decisions and alignment.

  • Identify gaps in customer journeys and shared web patterns, then work with the relevant teams to make practical improvements.

  • Create frameworks, prototypes, and reusable guidance, and provide constructive feedback that helps other designers and teams deliver high-quality work.

What You Could Bring

title: Backend Engineer - Crypto and Payments
description:
About GoTyme

The GoTyme Group builds digital banking products for customers in South Africa, the Philippines, and expansion markets across Asia and Africa.

About the Product

We are building a stablecoin and digital-assets wallet that lets customers hold, send, receive, save, and spend digital dollars through a familiar banking experience.

The financial core will be delivered in stages. In the first phase, a managed CASP ledger remains the authoritative operational financial record. GoTyme will build immutable event and audit records, a financial-control projection, and reconciliation capabilities around it. In the next phase, GoTyme's event-sourced, append-only double-entry ledger will become the product and accounting source of truth.

The system must stay correct across vendor events, internal state, on-chain settlement, fiat payment rails, card settlement, fees, FX, holds, and operational exceptions.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on Core Backend Engineer with strong financial-systems and database experience to build Project White's ledger, posting, reconciliation, and financial-control capabilities.

You will build systems that calculate balances, record movements of value, prevent duplicate or missing postings, and explain each financial state change. You will work closely with finance, treasury, risk, compliance, operations, vendor-integration engineers, and senior engineers responsible for the wider financial-core design.

This is an online transactional-core role. It is not a reporting or data-warehouse position.

What you will do

  • Build and improve an event-sourced, append-only double-entry ledger and its account, journal, posting, balance, hold, fee, FX, and adjustment models.
  • Implement posting rules and invariants that keep journals balanced, prevent unauthorised value creation or loss, and provide a clear audit trail.
  • Build transaction-processing flows for authorisation, holds, capture, settlement, reversals, refunds, chargebacks, expiry, corrections, and controlled manual adjustments.
  • Apply idempotency, deduplication, sequencing, and concurrency controls to payment, card, custody, and blockchain events that may arrive late or more than once.
  • Build reconciliation controls across the managed CASP ledger, Fireblocks, on-chain data, fiat ramps, card processing, treasury and accounting systems, and GoTyme's financial-control projection.
  • Build operational workflows for missing events, duplicate notifications, amount or currency mismatches, unbalanced postings, and suspense or repair processes.
  • Contribute to event schemas, financial data contracts, versioning, replay, and backfill approaches that preserve the audit trail without corrupting balances.
  • Work with finance and treasury to create accounting evidence, GL exports, reserve and liquidity views, and material for audits and regulators.
  • Apply strong practices for schema design, migrations, indexing, partitioning, data retention, backups, recovery testing, and database performance.
  • Take part in financial-core technical design and code reviews. Share what you learn about ledger modelling, database correctness, and safe production practices.
  • Own monitoring and production support for the components you build. Contribute to reconciliation service levels, incident response, root-cause analysis, and controlled remediation with the wider team.

Why join

  • Help build the financial foundations of a global stablecoin product as it moves from managed external infrastructure to a GoTyme-controlled financial core.
  • Solve database and distributed-systems problems where correctness protects real customer value.
  • Work with senior partners across engineering, finance, treasury, risk, compliance, and operations.
  • Shape the architecture and standards that keep the platform safe as it grows.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on work on payments, ledger, accounting, settlement, core banking, or another high-integrity transactional system.
  • Experience building, operating, or making substantial contributions to a double-entry ledger, payment posting engine, settlement platform, core-banking subsystem, or equivalent financial system of record.
  • Strong relational database and SQL skills, ideally PostgreSQL or MySQL. You understand schema modelling, transaction isolation, locking, concurrency, query performance, indexing, migrations, and recovery.
  • Working understanding of journals, debits and credits, chart of accounts, posting rules, available versus settled balance, holds, reversals, adjustments, fees, FX, and reconciliation.
  • Practical experience with idempotency, outbox and inbox patterns, event ordering, duplicate delivery, exactly-once-effect design, and failure recovery.
  • Experience building reconciliations that compare internal and external records, identify breaks, retain evidence, and support controlled repair.
  • Strong Java or Python experience and a record of building and operating reliable production services.
  • Experience with event-driven systems, including event replay, schema evolution, auditability, and eventual consistency.
  • Clear technical communication. You can work with finance, product, compliance, and operational partners to turn requirements into precise models and implementation decisions.

Strong plus

  • Experience in stablecoins, digital assets, crypto custody, exchange operations, or on-chain settlement.
  • Experience reconciling custody or ledger records to blockchain transaction events, confirmations, fees, and failed transactions.
  • Experience with Fireblocks, TigerBeetle, Modern Treasury, Mambu, Temenos, or similar financial-ledger or custody infrastructure.
  • Experience in card issuing or processing, payment acquiring, cross-border payments, treasury, FX, or regulated banking.
  • Experience with AWS serverless and event-driven services such as Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and Step Functions. Kafka is also useful where it is the selected event platform.
  • Experience designing data retention, partitioning, archival, and disaster-recovery approaches for financial records.
  • Experience with accounting exports, general-ledger integration, audit evidence, regulatory evidence, and operational controls.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a defined financial-core component.

Technology and ways of working

You do not need experience with every item below. You should be comfortable choosing and applying the right patterns for a financial system of record.

  • Financial core: An event-sourced, append-only double-entry ledger, a posting engine, financial-control projections, a reconciliation control tower, and accounting evidence.
  • Databases: Strong relational database skills are mandatory. PostgreSQL and MySQL are both relevant. Transactional correctness and performance matter more than a particular database brand.
  • Events and processing: AWS serverless patterns, including Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and workflows. Kafka may be used where it is the selected event platform. We use transactional outbox and inbox patterns and durable idempotency controls.
  • External records to reconcile: Managed CASP operational ledger, Fireblocks wallet and transaction events, blockchain data, fiat ramps, card processing, treasury, and the general ledger.
  • Engineering practice: Explicit financial invariants, peer review of financial changes, automated unit, integration, and contract tests, controlled migrations, reconciliation monitoring, staged rollout, and incident readiness.

Benefits

At GoTymeX, opportunities are here for the taking. If you want to be part of our purpose and live and lead through our values, we can offer exciting development opportunities through expanded lateral roles, stretch assignments, or people leadership.

Some of our benefits:

  • Competitive salary that recognizes your talent and potential, including 13th salary (pro-rata).
  • Performance-based bonus and equity participation in Tyme Group.
  • A fast-moving environment where your ideas and execution actually matter.
  • Full benefits and salary rank during probation.
  • Insurance coverage in accordance with Vietnamese labor law, plus premium health care for you and your family.
  • Generous 20 days of leave annually, including 15 annual leave + 3 sick leave + 1 birthday leave + 1 Christmas leave.
  • Meal and parking allowances covered by the company.
  • Hybrid working model with flexibility to work from home or the office.
  • Values-driven, international working environment and agile culture.
  • Work-life balance40-hr per weekfromMon to Fri.

title: Team for Nyttebereging, nyttemodell og indikatorgrunnlag for Altinn 3
description:
Her ønsker vi et team fra samme leverandør.

Avtaleform er SSA-O

Avd. Brukeropplevelse og datadeling (BOD) i Digitaliseringsdirektoratet (Digdir) har behov for bistand tilknyttet arbeidet med nytteberegning, nyttemodell og indikatorgrunnlag for Altinn 3.

Vi vurderer at oppdraget egner seg for et team av ressurser.

BAKGRUNN

Program Nye Altinn er i avslutningsfasen og har gjennom programperioden hatt ansvar for gevinstrealiseringsplanen. Programmets SSD fastsetter at leveransene skal legge til rette for langsiktige gevinster som realiseres etter programslutt.

Arbeidet skal bygge videre på Digdir sin interne nyttemodell

Les mer om programmet her: Program ‘Nye Altinn’

Les mer om prosjektet ‘Modernisering av Altinn’ i Samarbeidsportalen: Modernisering av Altinn

RESULTATER OG EFFEKTER Digdir ØNSKER Å OPPNÅ:

Formålet med anskaffelsen er å styrke grunnlaget for videre nytte- og gevinstoppfølging Arbeidet skal identifisere nyttevirkningene av Altinn-produktene, prissette dem så langt det er mulig og legge til rette for fremtidige målinger av realisert samfunnsnytte.

Ønskede resultater er en nyttemodell med definisjoner, datakilder og relevante målepunkter som kan brukes som grunnlag for oppfølging fra 2027,

Arbeidet skal spesifiseres nærmere sammen med valgt ekstern leverandør. Foreløpig omfatter det å:

  • identifisere og konkretisere relevante nyttevirkninger knyttet til Altinn-produktene

  • prissette nyttevirkningene der det foreligger tilstrekkelig faglig og metodisk grunnlag

  • gjennomgå og konkretisere indikatorer for videre oppfølging av nytte og gevinster

  • etablere eller avklare relevante måleenheter, datakilder, nullpunkter og målefrekvens

  • avklare ansvar for videre oppfølging av de indikatorene som skal videreføres

  • harmonisere metodikk og forutsetninger med Digdirs eksisterende nyttemodell for fellesløsningene

  • innarbeide Altinn-produktene i nyttemodellen, dokumentere nyttemodell, forutsetninger og indikatorgrunnlag slik at dette kan overtas og forvaltes videre i linjen

KRAV TIL SLUTTRESULTAT

Teamet sin hovedleveranse skal inneholde:

  • Kartlegging av nyttevirkninger for Altinn-produktene

  • Dokumentert metode og modell for nytte og verdsetting av nytte

  • Forslag til indikatorer

  • Anbefaling for videre styring og rapportering

DIGDIR ESTIMERER AT DETTE ER ET OPPDRAG FOR ETT TEAM AV RESSURSER

Digdir ønsker at leverandørens team har en egnet oppdragsleder – med tilstrekkelig kapasitet frem til leveransedato 18. desember.

Arbeidet ledes av Digdir sitt programkontor, og gevinstansvarlig i Program Nye Altinn.

Etter leveranse pr 18. desember, åpner vi for behov for videre dialog/avklaringer/justeringer – alt etter respons på leveransen.

Det er derfor vanskelig for Digdir å estimere behov i eventuell opsjonsperiode. Respons på leveransen vil være avgjørende; og om det er behov for omfattende avklaringer eller mindre justeringer

ØKONOMISK RAMME

Oppdraget har i utgangspunktet en øvre økonomisk ramme på kr 1 100 000 ekskl mva. Budsjettramme for 2027 og behovet for bistand i opsjonsperiode er usikkert; vi åpner derfor for dialog for fastsettelse av pris for supplerende leveranse/bistand. Øvre grense totalt for oppdraget er kr 1 980 000 ekskl mva.

Kompetanse/erfaring

MÅ-krav for oppdragsleder

  • Oppdragsleder må kunne vise til samfunnsøkonomiske analyser rundt IT-prosjekter og vise til erfaring fra oppdrag gjort etter utredningsinstruksen og DFØ sine veiledere innen samfunnsøkonomiske analyser og nyttestyring (tidligere veileder i gevinstrealisering)

Krav som evalueres

  • Oppdragsforståelse, og løsningsbeskrivelse

  • Tilbudte konsulenters relevante erfaring og kompetanse

Oppstart og varighet: estimert tidsperiode - 20. oktober til 18. desember 2026

Opsjon: Eventuell opsjon utløses i løpet av første halvdel 2027

Arbeidssted: Teamet kan arbeide fra eget arbeidssted

title: Solicitor - Charity & Social Enterprise
description:
About us

At Stone King, we're a purpose-driven law firm with a clear ambition: to deliver positive societal impact through the work we do with and for our clients. Since 1785, we've combined a proud heritage with a forward-looking approach, embracing change and investing in our future.

We work with many organisations and individuals who share our commitment to making a difference, including charities, social enterprises, faith-based organisations, educational institutions, businesses, public sector organisations and private individuals. We are nationally recognised for our expertise across the sectors we serve and are consistently ranked by Chambers and Partners and The Legal 500. Many of our lawyers are recognised as leading practitioners in their fields, reflecting the depth of expertise, sector knowledge and client service we provide.

We foster an inclusive and supportive culture where different perspectives are valued, and people are empowered to develop and thrive.

Our lawyers are more than legal advisers. They are trusted partners, problem-solvers and collaborators, helping clients navigate complex challenges, achieve their ambitions and create lasting positive impact in the communities they serve.

The team

Our talented people from across our practice teams have an extraordinary history of supporting charities and social enterprises on some of the most significant and impactful projects in the sector. Our work has included major charity mergers, innovative social finance and fundraising initiatives, landmark governance matters, high-profile crisis response work, the recovery of substantial charitable funds, support for campaigning and advocacy organisations, and pioneering legal developments that have shaped the wider charitable landscape. Collectively, these engagements have helped strengthen organisations that improve lives, support communities and drive positive social change. Joining the team offers the opportunity to work directly with recognised specialists on complex, varied and often high-profile matters, while developing your own expertise.

The opportunity

We are looking for a talented and motivated Solicitor to join our Charity & Social Enterprise team. This is an opportunity to develop your career within one of the UK’s leading specialist charity law practices, advising a diverse range of charities, social enterprises and other purpose-driven organisations.

You'll work alongside supportive and experienced colleagues, collaborating across teams to deliver excellent client service while continuing to develop your own skills and expertise. As your experience develops, you will be encouraged to take increasing ownership of matters and client relationships, with support from senior colleagues.

No two days are the same. Our work combines technical legal excellence with practical problem-solving for organisations tackling some of society’s most important challenges.

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Work on and, with appropriate support, take increasing responsibility for complex and high-value legal matters within the charity and social enterprise sector, helping to deliver excellent outcomes for clients
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with clients, understanding their aims and supporting their success
  • Work collaboratively across the team and wider firm to deliver a seamless and high-quality client experience
  • Contribute to a positive, inclusive and high-performing team culture
  • Take an active role in business development, including networking, thought leadership and client engagement
  • Identify opportunities to enhance client service, improve ways of working and support the continued development of the practice
  • Use and contribute to the team’s know-how, precedents and approved digital tools to deliver high-quality, efficient and consistent client service
  • Manage matters effectively, ensuring work is delivered to a high standard, in a timely and efficient way, and with appropriate commercial awareness
  • Maintain high professional and regulatory standards at all times
  • Continue your own professional development, staying informed of legal and sector developments

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of two days per week in the office. We are open to location, and this role can be based in any of our offices, including Bath, Birmingham, Cambridge, Leeds, London or Manchester.

About You

We’re interested in hearing from candidates who can demonstrate the skills, experience and behaviours required to succeed in this role.

Requirements

Essential

  • Qualified Solicitor with solid experience in drafting, legal research, file management and client relationship building.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and contribute effectively.
  • Excellent communication skills, both internally with colleagues and externally with clients.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • You will typically have sufficient post-qualification experience to manage day-to-day matters with appropriate supervision and be looking to develop a specialist practice in the charity and social enterprise sector.

Desirable

  • Experience in the charity and/or social enterprise sector is desirable but not essential. Most importantly, you will have a genuine interest in the sector and in supporting organisations that deliver positive social impact.

Personal Attributes

Alongside the technical requirements, we're looking for someone who:

  • Builds strong relationships and communicates effectively.
  • Collaborates well with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Takes a proactive and solutions-focused approach.
  • Manages priorities effectively and delivers high-quality work.
  • Contributes positively to an inclusive and supportive team culture.

Why Join Stone King?

At Stone King, you'll be part of a purpose-driven firm where your work has a meaningful impact on clients, communities and society. We combine sector-leading expertise with a collaborative and inclusive culture, creating an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to thrive.

Alongside meaningful and rewarding work, we offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, professional development and work-life balance, including:

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Profit Share Scheme
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Life assurance (4x salary)
  • Pension scheme
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • 28 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays. Enhanced leave provisions for key life events, supporting you through important moments both inside and outside of work.
  • An additional paid day each year to support CSR and volunteering activities.
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
  • A collaborative, inclusive and supportive culture
  • Investment in learning, development and career progression
  • The opportunity to work alongside market-leading sector specialists
  • Meaningful work that delivers positive impact for clients, communities and society

Want to know more?

This advert provides an overview of the opportunity. To request a copy of the full job description or alternative formats of the job description, please contact our Recruitment team at Recruitment@stoneking.co.uk.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Stone King, we value individuality and are committed to creating an inclusive, supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunities employer, committed to ensuring all employment decisions are made fairly and without discrimination. We are proud signatories of the Mindful Business Charter, Race Fairness Commitment and Age Friendly Employer Pledge, and are a Disability Confident Employer.

We aim to make our recruitment process as accessible and inclusive as possible and will make reasonable adjustments where needed. As part of our Disability Confident commitment, we will offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role, subject to any recruitment capacity constraints.

title: Country Lead - Thailand
description:
About Mitti Labs

Mitti Labs is building the infrastructure layer to scale climate-smart rice farming, starting with methane reduction, water replenishment and stubble burning reduction. We combine AI-based dMRV, satellite data and deep on-ground operations to verify practices and aggregate farmers at scale across India and South East Asia. Rice farming is responsible for 12% of total methane emissions and consumes 30% of the world's irrigated freshwater.

Our customers trust Mitti to deliver measurable impact across climate, water and food systems. They include some of the world's most sophisticated carbon credit buyers, such as Google and Cool Effect, and leading agri-businesses such as Ebro Foods and Syngenta. Since launching in 2023, we have scaled to 100,000 smallholder rice farmers and become a leader in high-quality credits. Our projects are certified by Gold Standard and Isometric and rated 'A' by Sylvera.

We are a team of 200+ data scientists, agronomists, engineers and operators across Europe, the US and India, and we are now aggressively expanding into South East Asia. We are backed by $12.5 million from investors including Lightspeed India, Aramco Ventures, Voyager Ventures, Godrej Industries Group, Cisco Foundation, Francis Family Fund and Volta Circle. Click here to watch a video on Mitti's work on the ground.

The Role

The Country Lead – Thailand is a founding role. You will design, launch, and scale Mitti Labs’ initial projects in Thailand. You will lead the team from our first pilot cohort of farmers to a multi-province, high-impact programs. You will wear strategy and operations hat and build a capable team from scratch.

1. Market Entry

  • Design and own Thailand's operations roadmap: regional feasibility, budget planning, and building partnerships.
  • Develop localized farmer onboarding strategies that reflect regional value chains, community power structures, last-mile realities, and seasonal farming calendars.
  • Navigate Thailand's carbon regulatory landscape: DENR carbon registry, Republic Act 9513 (RE Law), PCAF, and emerging voluntary carbon market pathways.

2. On-Ground Operations

  • Design and manage district specific operational playbooks -SOPs, training manuals, QA/QC frameworks
  • Build genuine trust with farming communities at the grassroots level — understanding local power dynamics, working with village heads, FPO leaders, and community mobilizes.

3. Team Building & Leadership

  • Hire and develop a high-performing in-country team.
  • Build a culture that reflects Mitti’s ethos
  • Manage external implementation partners and field agent networks

Requirements

  • +8 years in operations, agriculture, or rural development with clear evidence of building programs from scratch and scaling.
  • Direct experience managing agricultural field operations in Thailand - preferably rice.
  • Track record with government department and related NGO relationships is a bonus.
  • Experience in agri-input distribution or farmer community leadership is strongly preferred.
  • You speak Thai/Isan fluently. English proficiency is essential for internal collaboration.
  • Willingness to travel 40–60% across provinces and in remote farming areas.

Benefits

  • Build projects that matter: a first-of-its-kind climate and food-security program in one of the world’s most important agricultural nations.
  • Founding role: genuine ownership, genuine impact. You will be Mitti Labs in Thailand.
  • Work with a world-class team combining the best of science, product, business, and operations — with a culture of openness, direct collaboration, and unbiased decision-making.
  • Backed by leading climate investors with the resources to build for the long term.
  • Direct relationship with founders and leadership in a fast-scaling, mission-driven organization.

title: Principal R&D Hardware Design Engineer (Power)
company: HEWLETT PACKARD ENTERPRISE SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.
description:
Principal R&D Hardware Design Engineer (Power) - Next-Generation Networking

Engineer power at scale. Optimize every rail. Enable reliable networks worldwide.

At Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Principal Engineers are not just senior contributors. They are technical leaders who shape platforms, influence strategy, and raise the engineering bar across the organization. This role is designed for engineers whose power architecture and circuit decisions extend beyond a single design and whose impact is measured across products, teams, and technology generations.

If you are a power design expert who thrives on complex system challenges, leads through technical influence, and wants your work deployed globally at scale, this role offers both scope and impact.

HPE is a global technology leader built on innovation, trust, and engineering excellence. We empower Principal Engineers with broad ownership, autonomy, and the authority to drive complex technical decisions while collaborating with experienced engineering talent across disciplines.

Why HPE Networking?


HPE Networking is a strategic growth engine for the company, delivering open, standards-based solutions across Branch, Campus, and Data Center environments worldwide. Our platforms serve customers from growing enterprises to the world’s largest hyperscalers.

As a Principal Engineer focused on power, your work will shape power architectures, influence long-term technology roadmaps, and directly impact efficiency, performance, reliability, scalability, and cost across multiple product lines.

We are seeking a Principal R&D Hardware Design Engineer (Power) to join our hardware design organization, working on advanced networking systems where power conversion, power distribution, power integrity, thermal constraints, and system-level trade-offs are business-critical.

This role is for engineers who want to lead technically, mentor broadly, and see their power architecture and circuit designs shipped at global scale.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As a Principal R&D Hardware Design Engineer (Power), you will act as a technical authority for power architecture, power circuit design, and board-level power distribution, influencing designs well beyond your immediate deliverables.

You will:

  • Define and own power architecture and power distribution strategies for complex, high-performance networking platforms across multiple product generations.
  • Design and optimize AC-DC and DC-DC power solutions, including voltage regulators, multiphase converters, hot-swap circuits, protection circuits, sequencing, monitoring, and control.
  • Translate system requirements, load profiles, transient behavior, thermal limits, reliability targets, and cost constraints into robust power designs with appropriate margin.
  • Drive component selection and design trade-offs across efficiency, density, transient response, noise, thermal performance, reliability, availability, manufacturability, and cost.
  • Partner with system architects, board designers, signal and power integrity engineers, mechanical and thermal teams, firmware, validation, manufacturing, suppliers, and program leadership across global sites.
  • Lead power design reviews, simulation, schematic development, bring-up, characterization, compliance testing, and complex root-cause investigations from concept through production.
  • Establish power design standards, reference circuits, modeling practices, derating guidelines, and reusable solutions that improve quality and execution across programs.
  • Mentor senior engineers, guide technical decision-making, and raise power design capability across the organization.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Principal-level ownership of power architecture and power circuit design for high-performance networking hardware
  • Opportunity to influence platform power strategy, power density, efficiency, reliability, and product scalability
  • Work on advanced networking products deployed globally across Branch, Campus, and Data Center environments
  • Collaboration with experienced engineers, system architects, silicon partners, and power technology suppliers across global R&D organizations
  • Strong culture of technical rigor, hands-on engineering, mentorship, and sustained innovation

About You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience designing power circuits and power distribution systems for complex electronic products or hardware platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to define power architecture and make system-level trade-offs involving efficiency, density, transient response, thermal performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Proven track record of solving ambiguous, high-impact power design, bring-up, validation, and field issues.
  • Recognized technical leader who influences power design direction beyond a single team or project.
  • Deep expertise in power conversion and distribution, including DC-DC converters, multiphase regulators, hot-swap and protection circuits, sequencing, telemetry, and board-level power delivery.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with power simulation, measurement, validation, and characterization, including efficiency, stability, ripple, noise, transient response, thermal performance, and fault behavior.
  • Advanced schematic and board-level design experience using Cadence OrCAD and Allegro, with strong understanding of PCB layout practices for high-current and noise-sensitive power circuits.

Additional Preferred Abilities

  • Ability to operate independently at a Principal level, making high-impact technical decisions with minimal oversight.
  • Strong cross-organizational influence and relationship-building skills, including effective collaboration with silicon vendors, power suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
  • Exceptional communication skills, able to articulate power architecture, defend technical trade-offs, and influence senior engineering and management stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, strategic thinker with strong listening and mentoring capabilities, and a commitment to improving power design standards, methods, and reusable solutions.

title: Working Student - Fund Operations & Structuring (f/m/d)
description:
About Stableton

Stableton is a globally leading, tech- and data-driven institutional investor in private blue-chip tech companies. We empower institutional investors, private banks, and wealth managers to benefit from the value creation of the world's most valuable technology companies through our unique unicorn index investment funds and institutional thematic investment mandates.

With our disruptive mindset, fast-paced culture, and track record of innovation, we are reshaping private market investing. With seven years of 100%+ annual growth, we are scaling globally, and we're just getting started.

Your Role

This is a part-time role supporting our fund operations and structuring teams. You will take on the recurring documentation and data work that keeps our fund records complete and audit-ready: gathering account statements, logging them into our database, and working through structured clean-up tasks.

We are a tech-enabled firm and we expect you to work that way. Using AI tools to speed up repetitive work is not a bonus here, it is part of how the role is done.

This is not an internship. It takes time to learn how our funds and structures work and where accuracy matters, so we are looking for someone who wants to stay in the role and grow with it.

Your Responsibilities

  • Gather account statements and log them into our database
  • Work through structured clean-up tasks to bring fund records to a consistent standard
  • Support the team with recurring documentation and filing work
  • Take on ad hoc requests across fund operations and structuring as they come up

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree completed, currently enrolled in a Master's program in finance, economics, law, or a related field
  • Previous experience in audit, banking, or financial services. This is a must, not a nice to have
  • Available at least 50% alongside your studies. Hours are flexible so you can keep your studies on track
  • Ready to commit for at least six months
  • Strong Excel skills and comfort working with structured data
  • Fluent with AI tools and quick to figure out where they save time
  • Precise and reliable. You care whether a record is correct, not just complete
  • Comfortable working independently and asking when something is unclear
  • Fluent in English; German is a plus

Benefits

  • Real ownership of the documentation and data groundwork, not shadowing
  • A team that actually uses AI tools in daily work, and room to bring your own
  • Insight into how funds are operated and structured at a regulated Swiss asset manager
  • Close collaboration with a small, senior team
  • Flexible hours around your study schedule and a hybrid setup in Zurich
  • A role you can grow into over at least six months
  • If it works well on both sides, we'd be glad to keep you on full-time after you graduate

Stableton is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Software Engineering Intern - AI Enabled Software Development
description:
Job ID: 9711
Date Posted: October 6, 2026

Space Dynamics Laboratory’s (SDL) Strategic and Military Space (SMS) Division is seeking an undergraduate-level student to join our team for the summer in North Logan, Utah. In this position, the selected candidate will develop and refine software engineering skills while helping develop, improve, and maintain ground system web applications supporting space and national security missions. Interns will be paid a competitive hourly wage and tasked with varying duties based on current projects, needed support, and phase of development.

We are particularly interested in students who are already incorporating artificial intelligence (AI) into how they learn, develop software, and solve technical problems. Successful candidates may have experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or similar tools, as well as academic, project, or practical experience with machine learning or AI technologies.

The SMS Division delivers advanced satellite, sensor, and software systems that support defense and Intelligence Community missions. At SDL, you’ll become part of a team dedicated to applying modern technologies to challenging, real-world national security problems.

This position has the potential of continued employment or transition to student/full-time employment requiring security clearance eligibility.

This internship is for the Summer of 2027.

SDL internships are designed to bring talented students from across the nation together for unique, high-quality professional opportunities while expanding our candidate pool. Utah State University (USU) students have access to a variety of year-round opportunities with SDL through our Student Employment program. These positions provide USU students with valuable hands-on experience and professional development opportunities that can help them build their skills and resumes. USU students are not eligible for SDL internship positions and are encouraged to explore SDL’s Student Employment opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Writes clean, consistent, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Implements, tests, and maintains software for internal and external customers
  • Uses modern AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, explore solutions, generate and review code, troubleshoot problems, and accelerate development
  • Critically evaluates, tests, and validates AI-generated code and technical outputs
  • Collaborates with software engineers to improve existing ground system and web applications
  • Assists in deploying, integrating, and testing software applications
  • Explores opportunities to apply AI and machine learning techniques to software engineering and mission problems
  • Documents and regularly presents work and technical findings
Required Qualifications:
  • Currently pursuing a degree in computer science, computer engineering, computational physics, applied mathematics, engineering, data science, space science, or a related technical field
  • Must be an undergraduate junior or senior student
  • Minimum 3.0 GPA
  • Programming experience in C#, C++, Python, TypeScript, or similar languages
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding or software development tools
  • Demonstrated ability to understand, evaluate, debug, and modify code, including code initially developed with AI assistance
  • Experience with web application development, embedded development, or similar software projects
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Must be a U.S. citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Coursework, projects, research, and/or practical experience involving artificial intelligence or machine learning
  • Experience with Python and common AI/ML libraries or frameworks
  • Experience developing applications that incorporate large language models (LLMs), APIs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or other AI capabilities
  • Experience using version control and collaborative software development tools
  • Personal, academic, or team projects demonstrating creative application of AI or machine learning

If you are unsure whether you meet every qualification, we still want to hear from you. We are looking for curious, motivated students who enjoy solving difficult problems, learning new technologies, and finding effective ways to apply AI and software engineering to real-world challenges.

SDL delivers advanced multi-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners.

The application window for this position is expected to remain open for approximately 7 days; however, it may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. We encourage interested candidates to submit their applications promptly.

For questions, assistance, or accommodation with the application process or the DoD SkillBridge program, please contact employment@sdl.usu.edu.
